text: Five shipped strings carried runs of 14 to 27 literal spaces because a Rust line-continuation backslash was written through a Python heredoc, where the backslash is the heredoc's own continuation: the Rust escape never reached the file and the continuation line's indentation was baked into the literal. Four were user-facing hints in the check envelope. Detection is a run of ten or more spaces inside a string literal not preceded by an escaped newline; a sound gate needs Rust string-literal parsing, which is more machinery than one tooling artifact warrants until it recurs.
source: codex review of v0.7.0..HEAD, 2026-09-04; one instance predates the session (config/mod.rs, 63013c7)
